text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I wanna break away and run far, far from the Mejiro image that's been hanging over me. I wanna escape, and when I do…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I want to live the way I want—as my own self and without caring about what others think of me. I mean, I'm me, aren't I?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Like, sure, that's what I want, but if that kinda goal is so easy to achieve, then there'd be no such thing as suffering in life!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: After all, you gotta have the confidence to push yourself to live all-out, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But gaining that confidence is easier said than done. After all, there are so many incredible racers in this family…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro family bears a prestigious name in the Umamusume world. Many of them are regarded as racers with great potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Take the ultimate stayer, Mejiro McQueen, for instance. Then there's the buff powerhouse, Mejiro Ryan, among others…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It's nearly time for the intramural races to begin, isn't it, Ryan? It'll be us Mejiros versus everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Our objective is unilateral victory! You and I must win our races, of course, but so must every other Mejiro member!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Unilateral victory?! O-oh geez, don't you think you're setting the bar a bit high?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm sure not everyone'll be able to win. They'll feel real low, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Deep breaths, McQueen! No need to lay on the pressure.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If that happens, then I'll go around and cheer everyone up again! You can leave that stuff to me and focus on your own race, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Keeping things civil was always my job. Cooling off McQueen, helping Ryan out. But all that…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's not so much that I'm doin' that out of the kindness of my heart. I'm actually just trying my best to stand out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yup! Making sure things run smoothly is the role I play in the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: McQueen's endurance is legendary and Ryan's a literal speed demon. The only thing I can really contribute to the family is my charm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But that's important too, you know? Every family needs a mediator that keeps the peace and coordinates stuff. Except…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Once that mediator steps out the door, she's just a plain old Umamusume who's not even worth a second glance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer? I just want to be sure, but… Are you positive I'm the one you want to work with?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Now's your last chance to switch trainees. I'd totes get it if you wanna switch, so I won't get mad if you do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So lemme ask you again. Am I really the one you want for the Twinkle Series?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No one in the Mejiro family thinks I'll amount to much, and I'm super self-conscious about what others think of me. You're still okay with that?
choice_data_list: Yep. I want you to go down in history.
Yep. I want you to go down in history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh? Ahaha! We might be peas in a pod. Neither of us are willing to leave others out in the cold.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Thanks. But lemme say something first…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I wasn't lying about what I said earlier—about wanting to live my way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All my life, I've been forcing myself to act "more like a Mejiro" and whatever, but now…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I've gotta be a bigger version of myself. All right! Time to face forward and break away into the future!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer. In a family brimming with excellence, she's one of the Umamusume who tends to gets overlooked.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's always worked for a graceful, elegant running style befitting of a Mejiro, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… Aw, maaan… Dang it! Last place!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm so cooked. A Mejiro can't come in last! Everyone'll look down on me at this rate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's never managed to get great results running that way. However, one day, a freestyle race is held outside Tracen Academy…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Maybe I should give this whole "freestyle racing" thing a try. Yeah, I can run however I'd like here!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Okay, you got it! This time, I'll run like never before!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Watch me snatch the win and burn this run into your memories!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hraaagh!

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Paaal-mer! Paaal-mer! Paaal-mer! Paaal-mer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wow, everyone's so fired up… Hehe, and seriously, for me? I don't think I've ever heard my name called out so much…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'm SO hyped up right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She breaks free from her family's expectations and comes into her own with her explosive runaway style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And as they say, birds of a feather flock together. It's not long before she becomes fast friends with another explosive front runner.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Mornin', bestie! How're you doing, Palmster? ☆ Wahey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wahey-hey, Helios! What's up, sunshine? Listen, I'm finally gonna make my debut in the Twinkle Series! The date's been decided and everything!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: For reals?! Like, real life for reals?! Is it finally time for you to spread your wings?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You got me gagged with this news! That's hella lit! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! ☆ You're gonna do great, sis! I believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is Daitaku Helios. She's a friend of Mejiro Palmer and the one who taught her how much fun front running can be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two have been growing steadily closer as the days have gone by. As a result…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I just wanna get the deets straight for my debut, but what race do you think I should go for? Like, if you ask me, the peak distance would be…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, sorry! I didn't mean to hit you with slang. It's rude to talk to you so casually, so I'll stop…
choice_data_list: No need. I'd rather you be yourself than act all formal.
No need. I'd rather you be yourself than act all formal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What?! You mean you want me to keep using slang?
choice_data_list: Yeah, be the party girl of the Mejiro family.
Yeah, be the party girl of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Do you really mean that? Like, no cap?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yo, that's so based! ♪ You're, like, so much more alive when you're being your authentic self and not pretending to be all prim and proper! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: The world'll be shooketh after seeing your mad breakaway speed and hearing you stack on the slang during your interview! There's no way you won't make waves!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that idea is high-key gas, girl! Like, can you imagine me slangmaxxing during the winner's interview?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I gotta hardcore cram more slang words if I wanna do that for real…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'd for sure make a name for myself if I did that, though. And it won't be 'cause I'm a Mejiro, but 'cause I'm Palmer, the gal who ran free.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Should we do it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's go big or go home!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You coming along for the ride, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Heck yeah, count me in! ☆ Let's do thiiis!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right. My goal's to break away from my straightlaced self and all the Mejiro etiquette that's been hammered into me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yep, it's official! I'm runnin' as the Mejiro fam's ultimate party girl, and I'm gonna win, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Then, I'm gonna go down in history—my way! Not as a Mejiro, but as Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our goal is set. Mejiro Palmer doesn't just want to win—she wants to dominate as the party girl of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right! Are you two ready for this?! Let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No more being the peacemaker for me! It's time for me to blast off and run away into the future! Woo!
